old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a car tire stationary over four individually wrapped muffins placed on a gravel surface. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the interaction between the tire and the muffins. As the weight of the car is applied, the plastic wrapping around each muffin compresses, causing deformation and tearing the packaging. The gravel beneath the muffins is visible, providing a textured background to the scene. The muffins are flattened and crushed under the weight of the car.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a car tire rolling over four individually wrapped loaves of bread placed on a gravel surface. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the interaction between the tire and the bread. As the tire rolls forward, it compresses the plastic wrapping around each loaf, causing slight deformation but not breaking the packaging. The gravel beneath the bread is visible, providing a textured background to the scene. The tire continues its motion, moving from left to right across the frame, and the bread loaves remain in place until the tire has passed over them completely. The video captures the simple yet intriguing moment of a car tire interacting with everyday objects, emphasizing the contrast between the hard, mechanical movement of the tire and the soft, packaged bread.
caption: A low-angle close view shows a car wheel, its black Pirelli tire on a silver five-spoke alloy rim, resting on coarse gravel beside a horizontal row of four clear-plastic-wrapped packages, each holding a stacked pair of golden muffins. The white body panel at the upper left slides out of frame as the vehicle rolls leftward, the rim's spokes turning to show the tire rolling. The rightmost package is already partly compressed under the tire, and the ground-contact point sweeps steadily from right to left across the row. Each wrapped pair, plump and upright before the load, is squeezed in turn into a thin, spreading disc, the plastic crinkling and the paper cups splaying outward. The packages hold their positions along the line, deforming in place rather than being shoved aside. As the tire advances, the leftmost package is the last pressed flat within the view, all four now lying thin in the same row.
